# Gallimimus — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What does the name Gallimimus mean?", "chicken mimic"),
    ("What did Gallimimus eat?", "omnivore"),
    ("What is name meaning?", "chicken mimic"),
    ("What is period?", "Late Cretaceous"),
    ("What is lived (mya)?", "70"),
    ("What is length?", "6 m"),
    ("What is diet?", "omnivore"),
    ("What is found in?", "Mongolia"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
